name: Bervin Investments & Leasing Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1990, Bervin Investment & Leasing Ltd is in the business of leasing and investment[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
Company is registered as a Non Systematically Important Non Deposit Taking Non Banking Financial Investment and Credit Company. It carries on the business of leasing of assets / assets financing along with investment activities. At present, company provides various types loans to individuals and corporates and invests in securities

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -30.4% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -2.65% over last 3 years.
Working capital days have increased from 1,750 days to 5,110 days
